prompt_records.prompt: Six-second photorealistic single continuous live-action scene, fixed close camera with a believable physical sound source visibly moving in sync. Capture bold, physical, close-miked sound with assertive attack, convincing mass and clear texture: fast pressure movement, a decisive sharp transient, weighty mid/low body and a natural short decay appropriate to the material. Strong impact and realistic dynamic range without digital clipping, harsh distortion, cartoon exaggeration or synthetic tones. Three short separated takes of the SAME physical event, with varying force and texture, not copies: weak at about 0.80 seconds, medium at 2.50 seconds, strong at 4.20 seconds. Each take has its own explicit duration below; keep the gaps genuinely quiet and never overlap adjacent tails. Sounds must match what is visible and stop naturally before the next take. No background music, score, singing, voices, narration, chiptune, 8-bit sounds, UI sounds, artificial whooshes, cinematic risers, titles, edits or montage. A wooden striking mallet swings decisively into a dense leather-covered practice pad on a quiet workshop bench three times. Increase the swing strength each time; each blow has a short fast air sweep, solid low contact thump, and tiny natural surface movement. No rocks, no broken timber, no music. Each swing begins about 0.10 s before the pad impact at 0.80 / 2.50 / 4.20 s. The air sweep and impact tail together last about 0.25 / 0.35 / 0.45 s respectively, with clear quiet gaps.

alternate_use: Use as a layer with the reviewed route gain and start anchor.
For a new target, re-anchor the main onset and audition material/scale; matching peak dBFS alone is insufficient.
avoid_when: A crop carrying several audible events must not be repeated once per hit.
Source-specific rejected contexts are not automatically reusable.
